hero.subtitle: Machine Learning Engineer
hero.description: Machine Learning Engineer specializing in recommendation systems, personalization engines, and scalable ML infrastructure. Also building modern web experiences.

about.label: 04. About
about.title: Background
about.p1: A Machine Learning Engineer born in Tunisia and based in Japan since 2015, when a MEXT scholarship from the Japanese government opened the door to a career in tech across cultures and languages.
about.p2: Master's degree in Statistics and Machine Learning from Osaka University, with research focused on density estimation with autoencoders and normalizing flows. Professional experience spans research at NEC, production ML systems at LINE (LY Corporation) serving millions of users, and currently the first ML engineer at SNKRDUNK (SODA inc.).
about.p3: Beyond ML, experienced in full-stack web development — bridging data science and end-user experiences. Fluent in four languages and comfortable working across multicultural teams.
about.education_main: M.Eng in Statistics & ML, Osaka University

snkrdunk.h1: Joined as the first Machine Learning Engineer, building the ML infrastructure from the ground up
snkrdunk.h2: Developing recommendation and personalization systems for the sneaker marketplace platform
snkrdunk.h3: Built an LLM agent using LangGraph to extract business-relevant keywords from product names, powering the recommendation section of the app

line.h1: Implemented recommendation logic for LINE app official account suggestions, achieving 110% increase in CVR and +200M yen yearly revenue
line.h2: Built user-interest vector embeddings (dense & sparse) using PySpark, Python, and PyTorch, used across multiple LY Corp products
line.h3: Developed a high-performance Go-based API for personalized search result reranking in LINE Official Accounts
line.h4: Conducted PoC using Vision LLMs for image feature extraction, fine-tuning models in Japanese
line.h5: Optimized models by merging separate ML tasks into a single model, reducing maintenance costs
line.h6: Enhanced internal ML library, boosting task accuracy by up to 6%
line.h7: Implemented automated data analysis using LLMs with exceptional results

nec.h1: Contributed to Kurumie for Cities road damage detection service
nec.h2: Trained models from scratch and implemented a new technique that enhanced detection accuracy by 7%

rutilea.h1: Developed an industrial bolt detection service using computer vision, successfully deployed to production
rutilea.h2: Created PoCs using Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for 3D modeling, doubling the modeling speed

projects.label: 02. Projects
projects.title: Things I've Built
projects.jet_desc: A full-featured travel company website for a Japan-based boutique travel agency. Features include tour listings with filtering, destination pages, private guide booking, testimonials, and a fully responsive design optimized for conversion.
projects.rec_desc: Built the recommendation logic for LINE app official account suggestions, resulting in a 110% increase in conversion rates (CVR) and an additional 200 million yen in yearly revenue.
projects.vec_desc: Designed and maintained user-interest vector features (dense & sparse representations) capturing diverse behavioral signals, now used across multiple LY Corp products for personalization.
